title: tc-eval-scorecard
description:
Test cases run against prompt or model versions – pass or fail per case per version, the pass rate across versions,
filters by tag, and a case opened beside its expected answer.

heading.description: The heading – the eval set's name

versions.description: The versions in the order they were made – the last one is judged by the Failing and Regressed filters

cases.description: The test cases, each with its results per version

tags.description: The picked tags – a case with any of them shows; none picked shows every case

show.description: Which cases show: "all", "failing" (on the latest version) or "regressed" (passed on the one before, fails now)

open.description: The open case and version, or null for none

maxHeight.description: The grid's height before it scrolls, in px

runs.description: Runs of the whole set, oldest first – turns on the run history. A run whose id is a version's id gets its regressions from `cases`

baseline.description: The id of the run the others are compared with; null uses the run marked `baseline`, else the first. Changed by Set as baseline unless tc-baseline-change is prevented

label.description: Short – it heads a grid column: "v4", "Prompt 12"

detail.description: What else sets it apart – the model, a date; shown in the trend

status.description: "running" while its results still come in

name.description: What the case tests, in a few words – the row's label

input.description: The prompt or input the versions were given

expected.description: The answer a pass looks like

results.description: One result per version, by the version's id; a version without one hasn't run the case

output.description: What the version answered – diffed against the case's expected answer

score.description: The grader's score, already formatted or a number – shown with the result

reason.description: Why it passed or failed, in a line – the grader's reason

label.description: Short – it labels the run's bar: "Run 14", "Nightly 3 Nov"

baseline.description: The run the others are compared with – used when `baseline` isn't set

regressions.description: Cases that passed in the baseline and fail in this run. Left out, they're worked out from `cases` when both runs' ids are versions there

EvalRun.description: One run of the whole set – for the run history
